mapper.select: SELECT inbody_id AS inbodyId, user_id AS userId, weight AS weight, muscle_mass AS muscleMass, body_fat AS bodyFat, body_fat_percentage AS bodyFatPercentage, bmi AS bmi, uploaded_at AS uploadedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM inbody_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO inbody_data (user_id, weight, muscle_mass, body_fat, body_fat_percentage, bmi) VALUES (#{userId}, #{weight}, #{muscleMass}, #{bodyFat}, #{bodyFatPercentage}, #{bmi}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = #{weight}, muscle_mass = #{muscleMass}, body_fat = #{bodyFat}, body_fat_percentage = #{bodyFatPercentage}, bmi = #{bmi}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inbody_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC LIMIT 1
